title: stateRegistries
responsibility: Reads catalog and preview declarations as TypeScript syntax and required-state inventories as JSON without importing executable fixture modules.

inputs.name: stateRegistries.tree
inputs.description: Readable committed or working source tree supplying only the selected revision declarations.

inputs.name: stateRegistries.root
inputs.description: Project directory used for external inventory paths or read-only Git evidence access.

inputs.name: stateRegistries.extra
inputs.description: Additional JSON inventory paths, absolute or relative to root; defaults to an empty list.

outputs.name: stateRegistries
outputs.description: Entity-scoped state inventories with their source paths and catalog or required-state classification.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid selection, unknown identities, malformed inventories or invalid registry data with the specific CLI diagnostic.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Propagates Git, filesystem, source-reader and evidence-validation failures from the invoked operation.
